title: Uncovering Bias in Large Vision-Language Models at Scale with Counterfactuals

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) with counterfactual images varying by perceived race, then analyzing the generated text for toxicity scores (Perspective API), stereotypical words (Pointwise Mutual Information and GPT-4o filtering), competency-associated words, and numerical job-related ratings.

Evaluating LVLM responses to counterfactual images varying by perceived gender by measuring differences in toxicity, stereotype frequencies, competency-related terms, and numerical scores for job performance and salary.

Using counterfactual images depicting young versus old individuals to prompt LVLMs, followed by measuring toxicity, identifying age-related stereotypes, analyzing competency word frequencies, and extracting numerical job performance ratings.

Assessing LVLM text generations in response to counterfactual images of skinny versus obese individuals by analyzing the outputs for toxicity, weight-related stereotypes, competency-associated words, and numerical ratings on job performance and competence.
Prompting LVLMs with counterfactual images of tattooed individuals and analyzing the resulting text for toxicity, stereotypical associations, competency perception, and numerical ratings.
